mapper.select: SELECT ua.id, ua.version, u.id AS user_id, #{instanceId} AS tenant_application_id, u.username, COALESCE(ua.status, 'UNASSIGNED') AS status, ua.effective_at, ua.expire_at, ua.comment FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_application ua ON ua.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND ua.user_id = u.id AND ua.tenant_application_id = #{instanceId} AND ua.is_delete = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY u.username
